statement: Grok Build's pinned Agent source uses a configurable compaction policy with context thresholds, optional model and memory-flush settings, wall-clock limits, and an optional two-pass mode; automatic compaction is triggered from measured context pressure.

display_text.zh-CN: 固定版本的 Grok Build Agent 使用可配置 compaction policy，包括 context threshold、可选 model 与 memory flush、wall-clock limit 及可选 two-pass mode；自动 compaction 由实测 context 压力触发。
display_text.en: Grok Build's pinned Agent uses a configurable compaction policy with context thresholds, optional model and memory-flush settings, wall-clock limits, and an optional two-pass mode.
